risks.risk: YOLOS recall/precision, browser throughput, and thresholds lack a consented held-out surveillance benchmark
risks.mitigation: experimental label; no consequential action authority

risks.risk: CLIP similarities and association fusion are not calibrated and may amplify clothing/background bias
risks.mitigation: near misses, conflicts, open-set rejection, human confirmation

risks.risk: scene crops and embeddings can remain sensitive even without facial recognition
risks.mitigation: local-first, 24h startup purge, explicit deletion/export, no watchlists

risks.risk: browser purge is not a guaranteed wall-clock deletion service and downloads escape it
risks.mitigation: truthful best-effort wording and explicit reset

risks.risk: no authenticated email, ticket, dispatch, access-control, emergency messaging, or evidence-transmission service exists
risks.mitigation: controls unavailable; never simulated as success

risks.risk: automated axe/keyboard coverage does not replace manual assistive-technology testing
risks.mitigation: manual audit required before production readiness

risks.risk: browser model supply chain and malicious media decoder inputs
risks.mitigation: immutable active revisions, file limits, browser sandbox, CSP/SRI review roadmap

risks.risk: IndexedDB, quota, decoder, model download, memory, or WASM can fail per device
risks.mitigation: explicit failures, cancellation, coverage accounting, inconclusive result

risks.risk: local JSON exports are not tamper-proof legal chain of custody
risks.mitigation: SHA-256 integrity field and explicit non-immutable disclaimer

risks.risk: facial recognition, permanent watchlists, demographics, body or gait could be repurposed as identity
risks.mitigation: not implemented; rejected from normal query/index/action paths
